topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: The shadows grow long, and the ground feels unsteady beneath my paws. The air, once thick with the scent of familiar trees and earth, now carries a whisper of something else, something unsettling. I cannot shake the sense that the world has shifted, that the shape of things is no longer as it seemed. The friend who stood close, who shared the warmth of the sun and the shelter of the night, now carries a heaviness I cannot understand. The shape of their truth, once clear, now writhes like smoke in the wind. I pace, the leaves crunching underfoot, my steps quick, searching for the boundary between what was and what is now. The forest, vast and silent, offers no answers, only the rustle of its deep, ancient silence.
